name: Loupe
author: 0xBreadguy
description: Unofficial: running and waiting T3 Code agents in the bar. Click for a card listing them; right-click opens the Loupe dashboard. Not affiliated with Omarchy or T3 Code.

barWidget.description: Unofficial. A dot cell that spins, with a count, while T3 Code agents run, the bar's alert color with a diamond when one needs you, and an alert icon when it can't read T3. Click opens a card listing the agents, right-click opens the dashboard, middle-click restarts the watcher.

schema.label: Hide when idle
schema.description: Hide the icon while no T3 agent is running or waiting. It stays visible when T3 can't be read.
